title: Sechelt Roberts Branch 01 & 02 - FSR 7575 01 & 02
source_text: Sechelt Roberts Branch 01 & 02 - FSR 7575 01 & 02: Road construction for approximately 4.2 km of new forest service road will be ongoing along the Sechelt Roberts Branch 01 Forest Service Road between 8.4 km and 9.2 km, and Sechelt Roberts Branch 02 Forest Service Road between 6.3 km and 8.6 km. No road closures are expected; however, road users should be aware of increased industrial traffic and intermittent traffic control. This project is intended to shift industrial traffic away from sections of the road that are heavily used by the public, improving long-term safety and access for recreational users. For additional details and project bulletins, please see the BC Timber Sales Road Construction Notice: B&K Forest Service Road . Questions and concerns can be directed to: BCTS.SunshineCoast@gov.bc.ca
